pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING FOR INFORMATION: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.3 Reading for Comprehension (2 sessions) • Reading pace • Comprehensio
Topic 2.8: Reading for Information: Visuals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading for Information: Visuals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it good to make plans before carrying out an activity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading for Information: Visuals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading for Information: Visuals in the examples.
2. Explain Reading for Information: Visuals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading for Information: Visuals.
4. Show that you can: identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading for Information: Visuals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading for Information: Visuals important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read texts aloud about making plans and appointments for fun activities,
2. Team up to play a language game involving matching vocabulary to their meaning,
3. Learning to Learn: This is promoted as the learner engages in collective learning when teaming up with peers in class to prepare a planning record for fun activities

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it good to make plans before carrying out an activity?
2. How can we find the meaning of new words in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary from a text for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
